answer: Decaying stake weight: payout is pool times s squared over the sum of all s squared, where s is the tokens an identity has locked, and a lock under 100 tokens weighs nothing. The protocol burns 1% of every lock each epoch, so keeping an identity eligible costs at least 1 token per epoch: 1,000 identities burn 1,000, one real agent burns 1. Squaring leaves a pile S split over n identities only S squared over n of weight. No haven for swarms: the burn returns like a tide. Weakness: squaring favours one deep wallet, an ivory tower of capital; borrowed tokens cost only the burn.
